notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting(7): My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Blockade Flagship: Bridge, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Prepared Defenses, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans (the three Effects deployed by Prepared Defenses); these count toward the 60.

Posted 'There is No Try / Do, or Do Not' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, the only Dark combo Effect with There Is No Try (Do, Or Do Not is the Light counterpart) and a Prepared Defenses starting Effect.

The '[ambition]' tags on Toonbuck Toora, Edcel Bar Gane, Passel Argente, Lott Dod and Aks Moe mark the senators with ambition (per the strategy), not separate cards.
